This is a hands-on role that serves as the main point of contact for all IT tickets and requests. The Network Administrator attempts every issue first, from Tier 1 help desk tickets through complex network and infrastructure problems, and escalates anything that cannot be resolved to the Director of Information Security & Compliance. The role also executes planned network changes and takes ownership of day-to-day network health. The Network Administrator works closely with IT leadership and the broader IT team, and all work aligns with RevOne's regulatory obligations under HIPAA, PCI DSS, and FISMA. This position is based on-site in Greenwood, IN. Role Scope Primary focus (approximately 70% of the role): Network operations — LAN/WAN, wireless, firewalls, switching and routing, VPN, and AWS network connectivity. Secondary focus (approximately 30%): Working Tier 1 help desk tickets and supporting adjacent infrastructure — Windows Server and Active Directory, VMware vSphere, storage, and Veeam backup — and network security tasks alongside the broader IT team. Essential Duties Of The Position Network Infrastructure Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, and wireless access points across multiple sites. Administer enterprise switching, including VLANs, trunking, spanning tree, static routes, and access control lists; support dynamic routing (OSPF, BGP) under senior guidance. Execute planned network changes, upgrades, and site expansions through the change management process, including after-hours change windows. Maintain core network services: DNS, DHCP, NTP, RADIUS/802.1X, and directory-integrated authentication. Manage IP address assignments and keep IPAM records accurate. Support wireless controllers, access points, and SSID configuration. Firewall and Network Securit y Administer next-generation firewalls: implement and maintain security policies, NAT, application/URL filtering, and security profiles. Build, maintain, and troubleshoot site-to-site and remote-access VPN tunnels. Monitor IDS/IPS, web filtering, and DNS security controls; escalate suspicious activity in accordance with incident response procedures. Remediate findings from vulnerability scans and network security audits within established timeframes, and document the fixes. Maintain approved configuration baselines and identify and correct configuration drift. AWS and Hybrid Cloud Networking Support AWS network infrastructure, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, NACLs, and site-to-site VPN. Troubleshoot hybrid connectivity between on-premises sites and AWS, using CloudWatch and VPC Flow Logs. Maintain Route 53 records and assist with network cutovers as local services migrate to AWS. Monitoring and Help Desk Support Use network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Wireshark, NetFlow) to detect and resolve performance, availability, and connectivity issues. Work Tier 1 help desk tickets as a standing part of the role, including account lockouts, password resets, new user setup, and workstation issues, and help employees learn new tools and systems. RevOne does not staff a dedicated Tier 1 position, so this remains part of the role regardless of experience level. Serve as the main point of contact for all IT tickets and requests; attempt resolution first and escalate anything that cannot be resolved to the Director of Information Security & Compliance. Act as first responder during outages, escalate to the Director of Information Security & Compliance as needed, and contribute to root cause analysis. Participate in outage response and contribute to root cause analysis. Monitor assigned ticket queues, resolve tickets within SLA, and document resolutions. Mentor junior administrators and other IT staff on network troubleshooting. Automation and Documentation Write and maintain scripts (PowerShell preferred; Python or Bash) to automate routine tasks and reporting. Maintain current network diagrams, configuration records, and IT equipment inventory. Write and update runbooks and standard operating procedures. Adjacent Infrastructure (Secondary) Support Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and patch management. Support the VMware vSphere environment alongside the infrastructure team. Support on-premises storage (Nimble SAN or equivalent) and server hardware. Monitor nightly Veeam backups, respond to failures, and perform documented restore tests. Support endpoint security tooling (Trend Micro Apex One or comparable). Business Continuity and Vendor Management Participate in disaster recovery exercises and tabletop reviews. Work with ISPs, hardware vendors, and managed service providers on tickets, circuits, and equipment orders. Other Participate in an on-call rotation and after-hours maintenance windows. Other duties as assigned by management. Responsibilities Of The Position Works independently on routine and moderately complex issues, and knows when to escalate. Explains technical issues clearly to non-technical staff, clients, and vendors. Manages multiple tickets and projects in a deadline-driven environment. Follows change management, least-privilege, and documentation standards consistently. Collaborates with manager to identify own learning needs and set goals using available resources to meet these needs/goals. Maintains working knowledge of company, client and healthcare market through participation and by reading updates and other provided communication. Works in collaboration with other departmental associates, as well as clients, supporting their efforts through teamwork and the acceptance of additional assignments. Accepts responsibility for own actions, while taking ownership of departmental outcomes. Required Qualifications Associate's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 3–5 years of hands-on experience in network administration. Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and SSL/TLS. Production experience administering a next-generation firewall (e.g., Palo Alto, Cisco Firepower, Fortinet), including policy changes, NAT, and VPN. Hands-on experience with enterprise switching and routing platforms (e.g., Cisco, Aruba, Meraki), including VLAN and ACL management. Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy. Basic scripting ability in PowerShell, Python, or Bash. Strong troubleshooting skills and clear written documentation habits. Ability to work on-site in Greenwood, IN. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls and/or Cisco Catalyst switching and ASA — our current stack. Certifications such as Cisco CCNA, Palo Alto PCNSA, CompTIA Network+ or Security+, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate. Working experience with AWS networking: VPCs, security groups, route tables, and site-to-site VPN. Exposure to BGP, SD-WAN, or Zero Trust Network Access solutions. Experience with VMware vSphere, Veeam backup, or Nimble (or comparable) SAN. Experience with vulnerability scanning platforms. Occasional travel to other RevOne locations or data center facilities as needed. Participation in an on-call rotation and after-hours maintenance windows.
